item.title: Separate two jobs at a weekend garden
item.summary: A coordinator asks new volunteers to follow two different jobs after a storm.
item.transcript_text: There's mud near the shed, so go in through the gate beside the tool rack. If you signed up to plant, collect a tray of seedlings from Ruth. Each row already has a label. Read it before you dig because the plants in the green and brown trays look almost the same. If you are repairing paths, wait behind the tool rack. Kai will bring gravel when he has moved his van. Please leave the small wheelbarrow for the planters. We can share it after the last tray is empty.

questions.prompt: What is the speaker helping two groups do?
options: Start separate jobs in the same garden
questions.explanation: The instructions distinguish planters and path repairers.

questions.prompt: Why should volunteers avoid the shed entrance?
questions.explanation: Mud near the shed is the reason for changing the entrance.

questions.prompt: Why must planters read the labels?
options: The labels tell them how to move the van
The seedlings are difficult to tell apart
questions.explanation: The seedlings in different trays look similar.

options: At the end of a planted row
questions.explanation: The coordinator tells path repairers to wait behind the rack.

questions.prompt: When may the path team share the small wheelbarrow?
options: As soon as the van moves
After the last tray is empty
questions.explanation: The planters have priority until they finish the trays.
